job.duration > SONIOX_MAX_DURATION_MINUTES (env, default 250) and no translate_to
original file extension (from job_name) is qta and no translate_to

clientType is api or web (every request) and soniox passes validate

notes: Failover after a provider call fails uses the same chain minus the failed provider, and keeps only translation capable providers for translate_to jobs (provider-manager.ts:516-585). Only when preferences.fallbackEnabled is true (transcription.ts:543).
Language support is read from capabilities.ts: soniox and soniox_v5 = 61 minus 8 = 53 languages, deepgram = 61, runpod = 61. Comments in the file say 46 and 57, the code gives 53 and 61.

Language code on the wire is the 2 letter lowercase code from languageInitials: soniox language_hints=[code] only when a language is chosen, enable_language_identification is always true; deepgram query param language=code, model whisper-large (soniox.ts:119-141, deepgram.ts:150-160); runpod lowercases the code at runpod.ts:257 and uses model large-v3 (providers/runpod.ts:288-291).
Translation is Soniox one_way with target_language = ISO code of translate_to[0] only (soniox.ts:156-173). Deepgram and runpod have supportsTranslation false (capabilities.ts:31,104).
Speaker labels: soniox enable_speaker_diarization, deepgram diarize, runpod diarization params; no language gates them (soniox.ts:145-148, deepgram.ts:151,164).

RunPod endpoint env is STAGING when the UI locale is id, unless the feature_flags.runpod row names an env (utils/runpod.ts:50-60). RunPod is reached only if it is selected explicitly or wins the health sort.
Dead code: frontend/src/utils/transcriptionProvider.ts selectTranscriptionProvider returns job.transcription_provider or soniox; nothing imports it.

UNVERIFIED: supabase migrations set jobs.transcription_provider DEFAULT 'deepgram' (20251130113249_remote_schema.sql:1420). processJobsWithProvider honors a set provider (transcription.ts:507). If production still has that default, every web job skips this table and goes to deepgram. Needs mu to check the column default and the provider split of recent rows.

Rules 1 to 8 are the selectProvider steps in evaluation order. Rules 9 to 13 are cross cutting constraints (auto-detect, translation, language gaps, canary, model override) applied inside canHandle and validate.
